newsitem.title: UK: BFI rises 15 to 4-1/2 month high of 1,311.
newsitem.headline: BFI rises 15 to 4-1/2 month high of 1,311.

text.p: The spot Baltic Freight Index (BFI) was fixed at 1,311 on Thursday, up 15 points and the highest since June 11.

Brokers said stronger Caper rates have been reported in all areas including a remarkable $6.75 paid for 130,000/10 tonnes coal Richards Bay/Sines for first half December, up $1.10 from Portline's fixture at the end of last week.
Modern Panamaxes in the Far East have now achieved a level of $11,000 daily for Australian or North Pacific round voyages. Brokers believe this level will be exceeded shortly.

Rates in the U.S. Gulf area for Panamaxes do not appear to be moving up so sharply, although Continental are reported to have relet Konkar Star 69,500 tonnes dwt delivery prompt Passero for a trip via U.S. Gulf to China at a very steady $12,750 daily, they said.
